entries.title: Proverbs 2:1
segments: My son, if thou wilt receive my words, And lay up my commandments with thee;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:2
segments: So as to incline thine ear unto wisdom, And apply thy heart to understanding;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:3
segments: Yea, if thou cry after discernment, And lift up thy voice for understanding;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:4
segments: If thou seek her as silver, And search for her as for hid treasures:

entries.title: Proverbs 2:5
segments: Then shalt thou understand the fear of Jehovah, And find the knowledge of God.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:6
segments: For Jehovah giveth wisdom; Out of his mouth [cometh] knowledge and understanding:

entries.title: Proverbs 2:7
segments: He layeth up sound wisdom for the upright; [He is] a shield to them that walk in integrity;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:8
segments: That he may guard the paths of justice, And preserve the way of his saints.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:9
segments: Then shalt thou understand righteousness and justice, And equity, [yea], every good path.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:10
segments: For wisdom shall enter into thy heart, And knowledge shall be pleasant unto thy soul;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:11
segments: Discretion shall watch over thee; Understanding shall keep thee:

entries.title: Proverbs 2:12
segments: To deliver thee from the way of evil, From the men that speak perverse things;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:13
segments: Who forsake the paths of uprightness, To walk in the ways of darkness;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:14
segments: Who rejoice to do evil, And delight in the perverseness of evil;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:15
segments: Who are crooked in their ways, And wayward in their paths:

entries.title: Proverbs 2:16
segments: To deliver thee from the strange woman, Even from the foreigner that flattereth with her words;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:17
segments: That forsaketh the friend of her youth, And forgetteth the covenant of her God:

entries.title: Proverbs 2:18
segments: For her house inclineth unto death, And her paths unto the dead;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:19
segments: None that go unto her return again, Neither do they attain unto the paths of life:

entries.title: Proverbs 2:20
segments: That thou mayest walk in the way of good men, And keep the paths of the righteous.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:21
segments: For the upright shall dwell in the land, And the perfect shall remain in it.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:22
segments: But the wicked shall be cut off from the land, And the treacherous shall be rooted out of it.
